title: FireWatch FireObservation
description: Canonical representation of a single NASA FIRMS active-fire observation.

id.description: Unique deterministic or UUID identifier for the fire detection point.

sensor.description: Remote sensing instrument capturing the thermal anomaly.

processing_mode.description: Latency and product tier processing pipeline.

acq_datetime_utc.description: Observation acquisition timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

latitude.description: WGS 84 center latitude of the fire pixel.

longitude.description: WGS 84 center longitude of the fire pixel.

confidence_raw.description: Raw upstream detection confidence: MODIS reports 0-100%, VIIRS reports 'l', 'n', or 'h'.

confidence_class.description: Standardized categorical confidence mapped across sensors.

confidence_scale.description: Indicator specifying which measurement scale was reported in confidence_raw.

fire_type.description: Normalized classification of the thermal emission source.

fire_type_raw.description: Raw FIRMS integer code for fire type (0 = presumed veg, 1 = volcano, 2 = static land, 3 = offshore).

day_night.description: Solar illumination condition at the time of the overpass.

brightness_ti4_kelvin.description: VIIRS channel I-4 (3.74 µm) middle-infrared brightness temperature (Kelvin).

brightness_ti5_kelvin.description: VIIRS channel I-5 (11.45 µm) thermal infrared brightness temperature (Kelvin).

brightness_t31_kelvin.description: MODIS band 31 (11.03 µm) thermal infrared brightness temperature (Kelvin).

frp_mw.description: Fire Radiative Power (MW) measuring thermal energy release rate.

scan_km.description: Cross-track pixel footprint dimension in kilometers (must be positive).

track_km.description: Along-track pixel footprint dimension in kilometers (must be positive).

source_version_raw.description: Upstream data collection or algorithm version code (e.g., '6.1', '2.0').

satellite_raw.description: Raw satellite designation code from original payload metadata (e.g., 'T', 'A', 'N').

source_file.description: Originating granule, HDF, or CSV filename from which this record was ingested.
